review.limitations: P3 spot-checks, not a complete repeat of the audit. Original temporary helpers were removed; review.ts was independently rebuilt outside the repository. The startup profile, five-minute churn series, per-file test timings and feed-0/feed-1000 comparison were not repeated. Cold ledger microbenchmarks include JIT warm-up, and absolute host values vary. No container A/B rerun was warranted by the unchanged nightly baseline. All measurements, child processes and local fake servers completed before removal of the temporary copy.

checklist.item: Queries. EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for every query on the request path and at startup. Flag every full table scan (SCAN) and every temporary B-tree (USE TEMP B-TREE) over results.
checklist.evidence: A bun:sqlite preload (capture.ts) recorded every SQL text and src/ call site. It covered a fresh start with 4 channels, 150 s of polls with a new incident every 10 s (claims, deliveries, reminders, a permanent failure), GET /metrics, SIGTERM flush, 'failed list' and 'failed resend --all', a restart with changed routing and reminders off, and a JSON format-2 migration (timeout 400 bash capture-run.sh, exit 0). That gave 20 distinct statements, all in src/ledger.ts. grep added 1 more (setRecipients, email only). 'bun explain.ts capture.jsonl <state.db copy> <extra sql>' exit 0. Flagged: SCAN channels and SCAN entries in loadRows (src/ledger.ts:292, 297): the intended whole-ledger load at startup and in the CLI; ORDER BY rowid needs no sort. Every UPDATE and DELETE is a SEARCH on sqlite_autoindex_channels_1 (id=?) or sqlite_autoindex_entries_1 (channel_id=? AND key=?). Inserts have no plan rows. No USE TEMP B-TREE anywhere. /healthz, /readyz and /metrics run no SQL. The cost of the startup scans grows with the ledger (new Ledger(): 0.9, 3.9 and 35.9 ms at 630, 6,030 and 66,030 entries); see finding 1.

checklist.item: Startup. A CPU profile of the startup (bun --cpu-prof), with the top functions by self time.
checklist.evidence: Bench B startup_cpu_ms 270 ms, budget 455 ms: ok. Local CPU at the first /readyz 200 without the profiler (3 runs each): 1x 120/120/120 ms, 10x 130/140/130 ms, 100x 250/220/220 ms, bench config 110/100/120 ms. Profile: 'timeout 120 bun grow.ts ... prof-<n> 3 30 5000 <dir>' runs 'bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=100 src/index.ts' with SIGTERM at the first /readyz 200. 3 runs per size, exit 0. 1x, summed over 3 runs (1024 samples, 352.6 ms): createConvenienceMethod node:zlib:357 66.7 ms (18.9 %), native anonymous 60.4 ms (17.1 %), node:http module 26.8 ms (7.6 %), _onceWrap node:events:242 25.2 ms (7.1 %), @lazy 9.0 ms, toString 7.4 ms, DurationFormat (pulse-kit) 5.0 ms, node:dns 4.1 ms, zod init 3.5 ms. By nearest file frame: runtime and built-ins 59.1 %, zod 14.5 %, pulse-kit 12.5 %, src/index.ts 3.7 %, src/ledger.ts 3.4 %. 100x (2155 samples, 600.9 ms): bun:sqlite Statement.all 129.9 ms (21.6 %), loadRows src/ledger.ts:290 48.1 ms, readEntryRow 23.8 ms, isStatus 22.4 ms, pending 18.7 ms; src/ledger.ts 42.9 % (86 ms per start). No startup finding; the growth with the ledger is finding 1.

checklist.item: Costs that grow with data. The repository's bench, or a local A/B with a larger data set (for example 10x the bench seed). Report how each measured cost changes with the data size.
checklist.evidence: notify has no bench of its own, and the pulse-api bench gives it no incidents (finding 2), so this was a local A/B. 'timeout 200 bun grow.ts <copy> seed-<n>.db config3.json <fake api> <n> 3 30 1000' (PULSE_NOTIFY_POLL_MS=1000, 30-poll window, 3 runs, exit 0). CPU per poll: 1x (100 incidents, 630 entries) 6.33/6.00/6.00 ms; 10x (1000 incidents, 6,030 entries) 13.33/13.33/13.67 ms; 100x (1000 incidents, 66,030 entries) 20.33/20.00/19.67 ms. CPU at ready: 120, 130-140 and 220-250 ms. RSS at ready: 63.1-63.3, 68.4-69.2 and 107.2-107.4 MiB. VmHWM: 74.9-75.3, 85.1-86.1 and 119.9-124.1 MiB. 'timeout 300 bun ledgercost.ts <copy> seed-<n>.db 5' (median of 5): new Ledger() 0.9/3.9/35.9 ms; pending() x3 0.16/0.51/1.99 ms; prune no-op 0.1/0.3/2.2 ms; RSS delta after open 3.7/10.2/48.9 MiB. Bench case (one file channel, 5 s poll, 60 s window, 3 runs): feed 0 gives CPU 100/100/120 ms and VmHWM 65.3-65.4 MiB; feed 1000 gives 230/230/220 ms and 78.3-78.5 MiB. Scaling: poll cost is linear in the feed, which is capped at 1000 by the api default page; poll cost and memory are linear in the ledger entries, which have no fixed bound (30-day retention plus visible incidents, per channel); startup CPU is about 1.6 us per entry.

checklist.item: Memory over time. RSS after N minutes of steady load, against the RSS at the start. Name N and the load.
checklist.evidence: 'timeout 420 bun mem.ts <copy> seed-<n>.db config-mem.json <fake api> mem-<n> 5 <port>', 10x and 100x, exit 0. N = 5 minutes. Load: default 5 s poll; a feed of 1000 incidents with a new incident every 10 s that resolves after 90 s; 3 channels (webhook, webhook with remindEverySeconds 60, file); 183 notifications delivered per run; 0 error lines. 10x: RSS 69.7 MiB at start, 77.3 at 30 s, 81.0 at 300 s; VmHWM 84.5 MiB; CPU 1170 ms in 300 s. 100x: RSS 107.0 at start, 102.3-106.5 during the load, 106.1 at 300 s; VmHWM 123.0 MiB; CPU 1850 ms in 300 s. No leak is shown in 5 minutes (10x: +3.7 MiB from 30 s to 300 s). Against the budgets: 10x peak at 98 % of peak_rss_mib 86 MiB (finding 2); 100x above idle_rss_mib and peak_rss_mib 86 MiB (finding 1).

findings.title: The whole ledger is mirrored in memory and loaded with .all() at start; at 66,030 entries RSS is 102-113 MiB and the peak 120-124 MiB, above the 86 MiB idle and peak budgets
findings.command: timeout 200 bun grow.ts <notify copy> seed-100x.db config3.json http://127.0.0.1:18312 100x 3 30 1000 (and seed-10x.db as baseline); timeout 420 bun mem.ts <copy> seed-100x.db config-mem.json http://127.0.0.1:18313 mem-100x 5 18502; timeout 300 bun ledgercost.ts <copy> seed-<n>.db 5
findings.unit: MiB (median RSS at the first /readyz 200; median VmHWM 120.7 MiB)
findings.repetitions: 3 runs (RSS at ready 107.4, 107.3, 107.2 MiB; VmHWM 124.1, 120.7, 119.9 MiB) plus one 5-minute run (RSS 102.3-107.0 MiB, VmHWM 123.0 MiB)
findings.baseline: 10x ledger (6,030 entries, same feed and channels): RSS at ready 68.4-69.2 MiB, VmHWM 85.1-86.1 MiB; bench B idle_rss_mib 69.73, peak_rss_mib 69.82 MiB
findings.budget: idle_rss_mib 86 MiB and peak_rss_mib 86 MiB (gating); startup CPU 220-250 ms is within startup_cpu_ms 455 ms
findings.fixDirection: Read the rows with .iterate() instead of .all() at open, and keep less per settled entry, or look settled keys up in SQLite by primary key instead of mirroring them (the poll path reads them through has(), entries(), #olderReminders and prune()).
